messages:
Noah: Quick design check: switching from catalog list -> compare drops search text and filters. Super confusing. Thoughts on preserving minimal state? Elena: Minimal: query, filter ids, pinned model ids. Other UI state can live in session storage. That keeps deep links sane. Dmitri: Agree. URL encode keys, but if length > 1800 fallback to sessionStorage with a short token in the URL. Also add a patch endpoint so pins sync across tabs. Casey: Accessibility: when compare loads announce count and that filters were preserved. Use aria-live polite and focus the compare heading. Elena: Microcopy: use 'Pinned to compare' badge text rather than just an icon. Makes the intent explicit. Noah: UX: pinning from the list should update a small compare preview rail immediately. Less context switching. Dmitri: Motion: animate the row to the rail, but respect prefers-reduced-motion. aria-bot: aria-snippet:
Compare view loaded: 3 models, filters preserved.
Casey: QA checklist: URL state, session fallback, pin sync, compare preview update, aria announcements, focus rules. Noah: I'll file the board items under UX -> Model Catalog Compare and assign reviewers. Elena: I'll update Figma with the pinned label and reduced-motion variant. Dmitri: I'll PR spike for serialization today.
